summary: The exact Page and corrected PDF candidates pass independent exact-hash, repository-fact, document-plan, claim-accountability, deterministic-validation, internal independent-review, global presentation, idempotency, checksum-inventory, and no-write verification. PDF now represents all 15 selected verified capabilities in Mermaid and uses concise grammatical opening prose. No blocking findings remain for this two-repository task.

checks.detail: Get-FileHash SHA256 exactly matched each candidate-hash.txt, manifest candidate_hash, internal review candidate hash, no-op candidate hash, and the task-assigned hash.

Both manifests bind repository_verified facts and presentation-plan hashes. Page has 123/123 and PDF has 558/558 claim-map entries with a fact_id and verification_state verified. Deterministic receipts report fact_citations, source hashes/spans, protected_content, and claim_accountability_complete true.

Both deterministic receipts say accept with every recorded check true. Both internal independent reviews bind the exact candidate, use review contract v2, report ACCEPT, and identify qwen3-next through llm-route:merged-readme-review separately from deterministic composition.

Exact text comparison found Page 6 listed capabilities == 6 Mermaid capability nodes and PDF 15 listed capabilities == 15 Mermaid capability nodes, with zero missing or extra entries. PDF groups its 15 capabilities into three readable subgraphs and retains explicit PDF input and PDF/PNG/TIFF outputs.

PDF now opens with the grammatical sentence 'create, load, save, merge, and inspect PDF documents' and a concise second sentence covering representative verified editing and extraction scope. The previously mechanical 15-item prose concatenation is absent.

Each README has one H1, one five-badge header row, list-form navigation, full product display names, a detailed non-directional Mermaid diagram, collapsed long secondary detail, MIT benefit prose, Enterprise Edition terminology, two restrained products.aspose.org/products.aspose.com links below the fold, and no comments, internal markers, or emojis. PDF's example uses the full product display name.

Both manifests are complete, repository_verified, and NO_OP_PROVEN. Independent reconstruction verified all 223 Page inventory entries and all 88 PDF inventory entries with zero missing files and zero SHA-256 mismatches.
Both no-op receipts report NO_OP_PROVEN, new_provider_call_count 0, new_cache_reuse_count 1, patch_created false, duplicate_bundle_created false, and agentic_review_reused true.

Both preflight receipts set target_local_effects_allowed and target_remote_effects_allowed false. Each exact work clone is clean at the source revision, has origin pushurl DISABLED, and has an unconditional pre-push hook containing READMEAGENT_PUSH_BLOCKED and exit 1. No push attempt was made.
